title: Stochastic Multistage Constellation Reconfiguration Problem: Stochastic Dual Dynamic Integer Programming Approach
summary: Observation tasking is critical to satellite operations, enabling observation of planetary phenomena, orbital debris monitoring, and space domain awareness. To improve the effectiveness of satellite operations, orbital maneuverability is introduced as a leading-edge concept of operations within constellation reconfigurability for response to dynamic events.
